reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two independently reported phenomena—friction-induced oxide spallation (P2, P13) and microgalvanic corrosion between FCC and BCC/B2 phases (P18, P26, P32)—into a single synergistic mechanism for coupled wear-corrosion degradation in eutectic HEAs, and proposes a controlled comparison using oxide-stabilizing additions to test this synergy, which no single passage does.
copied_elements: friction-induced oxide film formation and spallation (P2, P13)
microgalvanic corrosion between phases in eutectic HEA (P18, P26, P32)
pitting on B2 phase in chloride environment (P25)
Y/Hf doping to improve oxide scale adhesion (P30)
